title: Handle FutureWarning from NumPy in Series Construction
selection_rationale: pandas compatibility with NumPy FutureWarning in Series construction.

oracle.responsibility_summary: Relevant code is responsible for Series operations behavior described by the issue and fixed by the selected PR.
oracle.hidden_resolution_summary: PR #26966: Surface NumPy FutureWarning about comparisons
resolution_comment_excerpts: Also want to look at `cmp_method` in `pandas/core/arrays/datetimelike.py`

The occurrences of that last one: https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/blob/d765dfbd53a70b94bc8e22b664d9235959832fd6/pandas/core/arrays/datetimelike.py#L59-L63 https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/blob/857515f60ef39d13d943969f6958e922f1e9b430/pandas/core/arrays/integer.py#L508-L512 https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/blob/d39249ad8ffc201dc7e92b063e2c8c2823b1cdc7/pandas/core/indexes/base.py#L98-L102

Looking through this again, I'm concerned I was overly-zealous in my filtering in https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/pull/22699. In particular, the `cmp_method` ones are probably bad. We're silencing the following ```python In [6]: pd.Index([1, 2]) == 'a' /Users/taugspurger/sandbox/pandas/pandas/core/indexes/base.py:84: FutureWarning: elementwise comparison failed; returning scalar instead, but in the future will perform elementwise comparison result = op(self.values, np.asarray(other)) Out[6]: False In [7]: pd.Index([1, 2]) == 1 Out[7]: array([ True, False]) In [8]: pd.Index(['a', 'b']) ==
Though I think we're OK pushing this to 0.24.2 or 0.25, since NumPy just had a release.
